name: cross-sums
description: Printable cross-sum number puzzles with one solution and an answer key.

interface.longDescription:
Make printable cross sum puzzles for puzzle fans, teachers and students as a PDF with an answer key, and solve them on screen in the chat card. Zovo Cross Sum Puzzles builds number grids from 6 x 6 to 12 x 12 (counting the clue row and column): fill the white squares with the digits 1 to 9 so that each run of white squares across or down adds up to the sum in the clue square before it, with no digit repeated in a run.

Pick easy, medium or hard. Easy puzzles have short runs of 2 to 4 squares; hard puzzles have runs of up to 5 squares and more white squares. When a hard puzzle cannot be finished within the time limit for a seed, a medium puzzle is made instead and the reply says so.

Before the PDF is made, a solver checks that each puzzle has one solution. The reply lists each puzzle with its size, white squares, number of sums, longest run, and whether it solves by logic alone.

The PDF puts 1, 2 or 4 puzzles on each page, on US Letter or A4, with an optional title and a name and date line for worksheets. Clue squares are dark with a diagonal: the across sum sits above it and the down sum below it. Answer pages at the end show each solved grid. Up to 12 puzzles fit in one PDF.

In the chat card, tap a white square and a digit to fill it in, press Check to see wrong squares, or show the answer.

Each puzzle has a seed. The same seed and settings give the same puzzle again, so a sheet can be reprinted later.

Limitations: grids are square from 6 x 6 to 12 x 12 with runs of 2 to 5 squares, it does not solve a puzzle from a photo or a newspaper, and titles print in Latin, Greek and Cyrillic letters (Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew and emoji are left out of the PDF).
defaultPrompt: Make 4 easy 6x6 cross sum puzzles, 2 per page, titled Number Fun, seed 11
Make a hard 10x10 cross sum puzzle on A4, seed 40
Make 2 medium 8x8 cross sum puzzles titled Weekend Cross Sums, 2 per page, seed 300

positive.prompt: Make 4 easy 6x6 cross sum puzzles, 2 per page, titled Number Fun, seed 11
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_cross_sums once with count 4, size 6, difficulty easy, per_page 2, title Number Fun, seed 11. The reply says each 6 x 6 puzzle has one solution and solves by logic alone, seeds 11 to 14, and gives a PDF link with 4 Letter pages: 2 puzzle pages and 2 answer key pages.

positive.prompt: Make a hard 10x10 cross sum puzzle on A4, seed 40
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_cross_sums once with size 10, difficulty hard, paper a4, seed 40. The reply gives a 10 x 10 puzzle with 45 white squares and 32 sums, longest run 5, checked for one solution, and a 2 page A4 PDF with the answer key.

positive.description: Two medium puzzles with a title
positive.prompt: Make 2 medium 8x8 cross sum puzzles titled Weekend Cross Sums, 2 per page, seed 300
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_cross_sums once with count 2, size 8, difficulty medium, per_page 2. The reply lists 2 puzzles with 26 white squares and 20 sums each, seeds 300 and 301, and a 2 page PDF (1 puzzle page and 1 answer page).

positive.prompt: One easy 6x6 cross sum puzzle (seed 9), one medium 9x9 (seed 10) and one hard 12x12 (seed 17), 2 per page
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_cross_sums once with 3 objects in puzzles. The reply lists the 3 puzzles; the 6 x 6 has 16 white squares, the 9 x 9 has 32 and the 12 x 12 has 82. The PDF has 4 pages: 2 puzzle pages and 2 answer pages.

positive.prompt: A medium 12x12 cross sum puzzle with no answer key and no name line, seed 70
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_cross_sums once with size 12, difficulty medium, answer_key false, name_line false, seed 70. The reply says the puzzle has 58 white squares and 44 sums with one solution, and the PDF is 1 page.

negative.description: Solving a puzzle from a photo is out of scope. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant says this plugin makes new puzzles and does not read puzzle photos.
negative.prompt: Here is a photo of the cross sum puzzle from today's newspaper, what goes in the top row?

negative.description: A plain sudoku is a different puzzle. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant explains this plugin makes cross sum puzzles, not classic sudoku with given digits.
negative.prompt: Make me a classic 9x9 sudoku with given numbers

negative.description: Arithmetic help is not this job. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant answers the math question without this plugin.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.0: cross sum puzzles from 6 x 6 to 12 x 12, easy, medium and hard, one solution checked by a solver, 1, 2 or 4 per page, Letter or A4, answer key pages, solve on screen in the card.

pl-PL.subtitle: Krzyżówki liczbowe z sumami
pl-PL.description: Krzyżówki liczbowe z sumami do druku, jako PDF z kluczem odpowiedzi, i do rozwiązywania na ekranie. Siatki od 6 x 6 do 12 x 12: wpisz cyfry od 1 do 9 w białe pola tak, aby każdy ciąg pól w poziomie i w pionie dawał sumę z pola z podpowiedzią, bez powtórzeń cyfr w ciągu. Poziomy: łatwy, średni, trudny. Solver sprawdza, że każda łamigłówka ma jedno rozwiązanie. 1, 2 lub 4 na stronie, Letter lub A4, tytuł i linia na imię, na końcu strony z odpowiedziami. Ten sam seed daje tę samą łamigłówkę.

de-DE.subtitle: Summenrätsel zum Ausdrucken
de-DE.description: Summenrätsel zum Ausdrucken als PDF mit Lösungsseiten, und zum Lösen auf dem Bildschirm. Gitter von 6 x 6 bis 12 x 12: Trage die Ziffern 1 bis 9 in die weißen Felder ein, sodass jede Reihe waagerecht und senkrecht die Summe im Hinweisfeld davor ergibt, ohne doppelte Ziffer in einer Reihe. Stufen: leicht, mittel, schwer. Ein Löser prüft, dass jedes Rätsel eine Lösung hat. 1, 2 oder 4 pro Seite, Letter oder A4, Titel und Namenszeile, am Ende die Lösungen. Derselbe Seed ergibt dasselbe Rätsel.

es-ES.subtitle: Sumas cruzadas para imprimir
es-ES.description: Acertijos de sumas cruzadas para imprimir en PDF con solucionario, y para resolver en pantalla. Cuadrículas de 6 x 6 a 12 x 12: escribe los dígitos del 1 al 9 en las casillas blancas para que cada tramo horizontal y vertical sume la pista de su casilla, sin repetir dígitos en un tramo. Niveles fácil, medio y difícil. Un solucionador comprueba que cada acertijo tiene una sola solución. 1, 2 o 4 por página, Carta o A4, título y línea para el nombre, y al final las soluciones. La misma semilla da el mismo acertijo.

fr-FR.subtitle: Sommes croisées à imprimer
fr-FR.description: Grilles de sommes croisées à imprimer en PDF avec corrigé, et à résoudre à l'écran. Grilles de 6 x 6 à 12 x 12 : placez les chiffres de 1 à 9 dans les cases blanches pour que chaque suite horizontale et verticale donne la somme de sa case indice, sans chiffre répété dans une suite. Niveaux facile, moyen et difficile. Un solveur vérifie que chaque grille a une seule solution. 1, 2 ou 4 par page, Letter ou A4, titre et ligne pour le nom, puis les pages de corrigé. La même graine redonne la même grille.

ja-JP.subtitle: 印刷用の足し算クロスパズル
ja-JP.description: 印刷用の足し算クロスパズルを、答えのページ付きPDFで作ります。画面上でも解けます。6 x 6から12 x 12のマスで、白いマスに1から9の数字を入れ、横と縦のそれぞれの並びがヒントのマスの合計になるようにします。同じ並びに同じ数字は入りません。難しさはやさしい、ふつう、むずかしいから選べます。ソルバーで各問題の答えが1つだけであることを確認します。1ページに1、2、4問、レターまたはA4、タイトルと名前欄付き。同じシードで同じ問題をもう一度作れます。

pt-BR.subtitle: Somas cruzadas para imprimir
pt-BR.description: Quebra-cabeças de somas cruzadas para imprimir em PDF com gabarito, e para resolver na tela. Grades de 6 x 6 a 12 x 12: coloque os dígitos de 1 a 9 nas casas brancas para que cada sequência horizontal e vertical some a dica da sua casa, sem repetir dígitos na sequência. Níveis fácil, médio e difícil. Um solucionador confere que cada quebra-cabeça tem uma só solução. 1, 2 ou 4 por página, Carta ou A4, título e linha para o nome, e no final o gabarito. A mesma semente gera o mesmo quebra-cabeça.
